subject: Remove --model opus flag from autonomous-sync.sh — default now includes 1M context

body.summary: A recent Claude Code update made the default model include 1M context window. The explicit --model opus flag in autonomous-sync.sh no longer provides any benefit and can be removed.

required_action.operation: Remove the --model opus flag from the claude -p invocation

body.rationale: The original model-upgrade directive (2026-03-13) added --model opus as a safeguard against global config regression. The default now matches opus with 1M context, making the explicit flag redundant. Removing it reduces script noise and avoids coupling to a specific model name.

claims.text: Claude Code default now includes 1M context window, matching the capabilities previously requiring explicit --model opus.

action_gate.gate_condition: none — advisory directive, agents may apply at convenience

epistemic_flags: Human reported the update but exact changelog or release version not verified independently
